bio.text: Delia Ramirez represents Illinois's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House and, according to her office, is the first Latina elected to Congress from Illinois.
She previously served two terms in the Illinois General Assembly after being elected in 2018 to the 4th House District.
She spent about 18 years in the nonprofit sector, including as executive director of the Center for Changing Lives, and graduated from Northeastern Illinois University.
She is a lifelong resident of Chicago's Humboldt Park neighborhood and lives in Chicago.
